summary: The Nancy & Stephen Grand Family House is an 80-bedroom, ~92,000 sq ft nonprofit facility at 540 Mission Bay Blvd North (Mission Bay Block 7 East) providing free housing for families of children treated at UCSF Benioff Children's Hospital. DataSF Assessor records date its construction to 2016, matching UC San Francisco's own news office, which reported the building opened in May 2016.

milestones.text: The Commission on Community Investment and Infrastructure (OCII), successor to the Mission Bay Redevelopment Agency, adopts Resolution No. 10-2014, adopting CEQA findings and conditionally approving the combined basic concept and schematic design for Family House, Inc.'s institutional building on Block 7 East
New Family House building opened at Mission Bay, welcoming its first families.

open_questions: The UCSF News article could not be directly rendered in this session (its host returned 403 to automated fetches, and archive.org is blocked by this session's egress policy); its May 2016 opening date is taken from the article's own title/URL slug and is corroborated by independent secondary reporting (an SF Examiner 10-year-anniversary piece and a Hoodline article on the move), but the page's full text was not read firsthand here -- worth a follow-up direct read.
Exact day within May 2016 is not sourced, only the month.

A separate Family House article title found in search ('Grand Family House Grand Opening Ribbon Cutting... March 2, 2016') suggests a ribbon-cutting ceremony preceded the May 2016 move-in date, but that page returned 404 when fetched directly and its content could not be confirmed -- not used as a citation here.
